mryan: customers reported a sudden spike in streaming tokens during a scheduled route handoff in ap-south. billing shows overlapping active leases. can we investigate? :confused:

josh: can you paste a trace id and a sample session id? i'll grep the routing logs.

mryan: trace=tr-2026-03-AP-HANDOFF-22 sess=s-0b9cde. quick excerpt:
```
2026-03-25T21:05:05Z INFO route_claim shard=ap-3 session=s-0b9cde lease=lease-88 owner=pool-ap-1
2026-03-25T21:05:06Z INFO drain_start shard=ap-3 session=s-0b9cde to=pool-ap-2
2026-03-25T21:05:06Z INFO resume_handled shard=ap-2 session=s-0b9cde resume_token=rt-old billing_mark=active
2026-03-25T21:05:07Z INFO lease_tombstone lease=lease-88
```
looks like resume_handled precedes tombstone. billing marks both as active.

tara: that's the classic resume-before-tombstone race. short-term mitigation: add a console alert for per-route active_count sharp deltas and bump sampling around handoffs so we have more traces. long-term: we need a deterministic lifecycle event so billing can dedupe.

josh: implementation choices: 1) add X-Prev-Lease header on resume requests; 2) extend resume_token to carry prev lease (token v2). Header is easiest to start, token v2 cleaner long-term.

mryan: header has lower rollout risk (server ignores unknown headers) but requires client SDK updates. token v2 forces token churn but centralizes info.

tara: propose incremental plan: A) today: console alert + sampling bump; B) next sprint: header acceptance + lifecycle event emitted; C) later: token v2 and retire header.

ops-bot: canary scheduled -> pool-ap-2 streaming-service v2026.03.25-canary-1 for 20m.

josh: i'll wire the console alert: active_count delta > 3x baseline in 5m -> tenant flag "suspected-handoff-dup". will also increase sampling to 15% for handoff windows.

mryan: thanks. tara please draft the lifecycle event schema (session_id, prev_lease, new_lease, event_time, event_type) and send to billing. attach the customer's billing dump to the ticket.

tara: will do. assigning TASK-4527 to myself for schema + sample logs.

josh: updating thread after canary run with log grep results.

mryan: appreciated. if customers escalate, we'll post a short note on status.redwood.ai. :thumbsup:
